stronger_left_out.name: Wilpena Pound Resort
stronger_left_out.reason: Accommodation and visitor centre, a business; the place is Wilpena Pound/Ikara-Flinders Ranges NP (rule 2, vehicle/operator not a spot).

stronger_left_out.name: Ediacara Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage names the Ediacara fossil site (Dickinsonia), a world-significant place. Against: the fossil site at Nilpena is reached only through booked station tours, so open public access is doubtful; one counted source.

stronger_left_out.name: Terowie
stronger_left_out.reason: outside the region: belongs to sa-barossa-clare (Mid North wheatbelt south of Peterborough). Historic railway town; the heritage walk and museums (web search) make it a good keep there. Counted source not confirmed.

stronger_left_out.name: Crystal Brook
stronger_left_out.reason: Only listed by name among the region's towns; no source names anything to see or do (rule 1/2).

stronger_left_out.name: Wilmington
stronger_left_out.reason: Town wrapper: the flindersandoutback regional page lists it only as a town link, and its draws (Hancock's Lookout, Horrocks Pass) are listed separately as spots; no distinct sight of its own named.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Frome
stronger_left_out.reason: For: parks.sa.gov.au names the 100 km salt lake as a feature of Vulkathunha-Gammon Ranges. Against: ephemeral, edge reached only by 4WD, no named viewpoint or walk; one source.

stronger_left_out.name: Spalding
stronger_left_out.reason: Named only as the southern edge of the region; no source names a thing to see (rule 1/2).

stronger_left_out.name: Powell Gardens
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a small native garden in Quorn parklands (listing opened); a local park. Wikipedia coordinates refer to a Missouri garden of the same name, so the match is wrong.

stronger_left_out.name: Mawson Plateau
stronger_left_out.reason: Only reached via the Arkaroola ridgetop tour; a tour destination, no open public access of its own (rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Copley
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage lists a cafe and information stop only; nothing to see or do (rule 2, shop/cafe).

stronger_left_out.name: Nepabunna
stronger_left_out.reason: Community; the only draw is Iga Warta cultural tours, an operator, and visitor access is by arrangement (rule 2, operator).

stronger_left_out.name: Wooltana Station
stronger_left_out.reason: A working pastoral station; no counted visitor source and no public visit.

stronger_left_out.name: Arkaba Walk
stronger_left_out.reason: A four-night guided luxury walk run by an operator on a private station (operator, rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Gee
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source found after searching; remote peak in the Arkaroola area, not a named visitor stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Ajax Mine Fossil Reef
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: a heritage-listed fossil site on the Puttapa pastoral lease; searches found no public access or visitor page, access only on guided tours.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Serle
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source found after searching; a peak on a pastoral station with no visitor page.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Brown
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Mount Brown Conservation Park (the peak is the park's summit walk).

stronger_left_out.name: Moolawatana Station
stronger_left_out.reason: A working pastoral station; no counted visitor source and no public visit.

stronger_left_out.name: Willochra Plain
stronger_left_out.reason: A broad plain seen from lookouts, no place to go (rule 3: part of the lookout views).

stronger_left_out.name: Willochra Creek
stronger_left_out.reason: A creek; no counted visitor source naming it as a place to go.

stronger_left_out.name: Elder Range (Merna Mora)
stronger_left_out.reason: 4WD track accessible only from a private station; a list mention (rule 2).

stronger_left_out.name: Buckaringa Sanctuary
stronger_left_out.reason: AWC sanctuary: AWC's own page gives no visitor arrangements and the Heysen Trail route there has been closed for feral-animal control; no public visit or counted visitor source found (searched AWC, web search, ExplorOz).

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Hack
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source found; the summit lies on the Warraweena property reached only by 4WD track via the station, not a public visit page.

stronger_left_out.name: Kanalla Falls
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted visitor source found (searched web, Wikipedia only); a waterfall inside Ikara-Flinders Ranges National Park, part of the larger park spot, flows only after rain.

stronger_left_out.name: Baroota Dam
stronger_left_out.reason: A water reservoir; no counted visitor source found.
